findings.title: Abstract base class with a single implementer
findings.tldr: StorageBackend is an ABC with one concrete class (S3Backend); no second impl is in scope.
findings.failure_scenario: Future 'add a new backend' work is a 30-line refactor instead of a 5-line subclass; cost paid now (YAGNI) for hypothetical future work.

findings.title: make_storage factory with one return value
findings.tldr: The factory function `make_storage` returns the only concrete type; the indirection adds no flexibility.
findings.failure_scenario: Every caller of make_storage() is tied to S3Backend via the type; the indirection is purely cosmetic.
findings.fix: Remove make_storage; instantiate S3Backend directly at the call site.
